Archive // 002

Universe.

Every project starts as a question. Unholy Bends is just me answering it differently each time.

Honestly, there was never really a plan. I just kept turning whatever I was feeling into something I could record. Hop On happened because I was young, in love, and had no idea what to do with either of those things. Then came Oblivion — I still didn't really know what my sound was, so I let every track sound like something different and figured that was the answer for now. Somewhere between that and Velvet Skies, things kind of clicked. The noise got a bit more honest, closer to what I actually wanted to make.

I still don't have this mapped out, for the record. What you're hearing is just whatever version of me existed on the day it got recorded.

How it bent

Still didn't know what my sound was, so every track went its own way. Co-produced with Ow Feng.

2025
A new era

Velvet Skies

The noise got more honest. First sign of the album that's coming next, co-written with Ow Feng.
